_doc: Prompt descriptors for the AI sprite Workshop. Every generation = the groups below joined in order (medium, style, proportions, view, rendering, framing, world) + the build or part text. Edit them in the Workshop's Style tab. FLUX.2-klein distilled runs at CFG 1, so there are NO negative prompts: say what you want ('hard edges', 'clean outlines'), not what you don't. Research notes: vault 'Hearthdelve - Sprite Prompting'.

medium.text: Adventurer, Dark Fantasy, Dungeons and Dragons, Dungeon Crawler, quasi pixel art
medium.hint: What it is. 'pixel art sprite' is the pixel LoRA's trigger. '16-bit' = SNES-era richness; 'modern pixel art' = cleaner, more colours; '8-bit' = blocky, few colours.

style.hint: Style references. Game names steer strongly; swap for e.g. 'Sea of Stars', 'Triangle Strategy', 'Chrono Trigger'.

proportions.text: chibi, super deformed, about 2.5 heads tall, oversized head, small body, short stubby legs
proportions.hint: Models drift to realistic proportions unless pushed. 'super deformed' + 'oversized head' matter most.

view.text: full body, three-quarter view facing left, standing idle pose, arms relaxed at the sides, feet together, floating in empty space
view.hint: Keep identical for every generation so parts line up. The back base is made by editing the front one.

rendering.text: clean dark outlines, two-tone cel shading, hard edges, crisp pixels, limited palette
rendering.hint: Line and shading language. Useful extras: 'selective outlines', 'dithering', 'high contrast', 'muted earthy colours'.

framing.text: single character, centered, game asset, isolated on a pure flat white background, nothing beneath the feet
framing.hint: Plain white background is required: the cutter uses it to find the sprite. Ground shadow: keep "nothing beneath the feet" here and "floating in empty space" in view, and avoid the word "shadow" anywhere (tested 2026-10-20: shadows on 4 of 4 seeds before, 0 of 4 after).

world.hint: Tone of the setting, e.g. 'gritty dungeon delver', 'weathered, battle-worn', 'storybook fantasy'.

base.text: plain grey shorts, barefoot, neutral expression
base.hint: Shared mannequin clothing. Keep it plain so outfits, hair and hats can be swapped. Each build below adds sex, body, bald head and top.

builds.male: male adventurer, bald head, average athletic build, plain grey sleeveless undershirt
builds.female: female adventurer, bald head, average athletic build, plain grey tank top
builds.slim: legacy first test mannequin (child-like, unisex): bald head, plain grey sleeveless undershirt

_buildsDoc: One mannequin per build; parts are generated and approved per build. Add more any time, e.g. "male_broad": "male, bald head, broad-shouldered stocky build, plain grey undershirt".
back_view: Show this exact same character from behind, in a three-quarter back view facing up and to the left. Same size, same position, same pixel art style.
part_suffix: Keep exactly the same character, pose, framing, size and pixel art style. Change nothing else.

slot_verbs.head: Put on the character's head:
slot_verbs.back: Give the character, worn on the back,
slot_verbs.mainhand: Put in the character's right hand:
slot_verbs.offhand: Put in the character's left hand or arm:
